name: Kisan Call Centre (KCC)
purpose: Free agricultural advisory helpline. Get expert advice on farming, crop diseases, soil, and schemes.
source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India

name: PM-KISAN Helpline
purpose: For queries about PM-KISAN benefit status, registration, corrections, and payment issues.
availability: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM
source: PM-KISAN / Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

name: PMFBY Crop Insurance Helpline
purpose: For crop insurance queries, claim status, and grievances under PMFBY.
availability: Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM
source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India

name: NABARD Helpline
purpose: For queries about rural credit, KCC (Kisan Credit Card), and NABARD schemes.
availability: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM
source: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)

name: ICAR (Indian Council of Agricultural Research)
purpose: Agricultural research, crop variety, and technology information.

name: National Seeds Corporation (NSC)
purpose: For certified seed availability, seed quality complaints, and dealer information.

name: Kisaan Sarathi (mKisaan Portal)
purpose: Mobile advisory service — SMS crop advisories, weather, and market prices in local language.
source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
